notes: Expansion paired with grammar-replace-0019 (a single gerund phrase takes a plural verb; relation takes_verb_form and the new value, a plural verb, are kept). Fictional subject: a made-up class, plovish company names (the name of one small company in a craft), under the real class 'company name', which leaves the verb number open (British English often takes a plural verb, American a singular), so the rule fills an empty slot; a class under 'gerund phrase', whose singular verb is fixed, would overwrite inherited knowledge.
